inlines.v: SEW'ER, noun [Latin sicco.] A drain or passage to cnvey off waterunder ground; a subterraneous canal, particularly in cities; corruptly pronounced Shore or soer. SEW'ER, noun An officer who serves up the feast and arranges the dishes. Obs. SEW'ER, noun One who sews, or uses the needle.
